# Opening Mahjong tile handling

- Title: tiles fall on corkboard
- Author: Detective_Lemons
- Source: https://freesound.org/people/Detective_Lemons/sounds/785585/
- Public high-quality MP3: https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/785/785585_16768120-hq.mp3
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0
- License URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Original SHA-256: `2655e1c6d8d6680a88c00c0f4d9641704bbcd1ec3962664b9425e70745a143bb`

This is the recording used in the approved `mahjong-b-cc0-recorded-tiles.mp3`
audition. The creator recorded the tile handling for the film "mahjong cowboy".

`assets/audio/mahjong/table/deal.ogg` contains the continuous collisions at
0.540–0.840 seconds of the original recording. It is mono 48kHz Ogg Vorbis
quality 5, with 6ms edge fades and a 0.40 normalized peak. At 300ms, each cue fits
inside the opening deal's 320ms batch interval without stacking long recordings.

Only multi-tile opening pickups use this recording. Single draws and discards
use the corresponding SFXMint sources from `mahjong-c-ai-draw-discard.mp3`.
The vendor directory is outside the runtime asset roots.
